description: This file implements an RPC-based HTTP response writer and server for a Mattermost plugin, including methods for handling headers, writing responses, flushing, and connection management.

classes.name: hijackedResponse
classes.description: Represents a hijacked network connection with buffered read/write and read buffer.

classes.name: httpResponseWriterRPCServer
classes.description: RPC server implementation for handling HTTP response writing, headers, and flushing.

classes.name: httpResponseWriterRPCClient
classes.description: RPC client implementation for sending HTTP responses, headers, and flush commands over RPC.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Returns the HTTP headers, populating via RPC if not already set.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes bytes to the HTTP response via RPC.

methods.name: WriteHeader
methods.description: Sets the HTTP status code after validating it.

methods.name: SyncHeader
methods.description: Synchronizes headers between client and server.

methods.name: connectHTTPResponseWriter
methods.description: Creates an RPC client for the HTTP response writer over a network connection.
